run.name: Bausch Health Companies Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (BHC)
run.summary: Bausch Health is a highly leveraged credit on an improving path: leverage and liquidity improved in 2026, but profit depends on Xifaxan ahead of a 2027 price reset and the 2028 to 2031 maturities remain large. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (derived), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt 20,168, cash and equivalents 2,485, LTM derived EBITDA before goodwill impairments 3,918. Same basis and limits; adjusted EBITDA based ratio is Not calculable (no fourth quarter 2025 adjusted EBITDA).

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Derived EBITDA before goodwill impairments 3,276 over interest paid 1,810 (10-K page:319), which includes 276 of interest recorded as a reduction of the 2022 Secured Notes premium. Consolidated.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents at September 30, 2026. Undrawn: 469 (500 commitment less 31 letters of credit) plus B+L 666 (Q3 10-Q page:32, page:36). Consolidated; Bausch + Lomb cash 515 (incl. restricted) and its revolver are generally not available to the parent.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No debt documents, covenant calculation or fourth quarter 2025 adjusted EBITDA are supplied, so headroom, legal capacity and an adjusted leverage ratio cannot be verified.
CP-1 main limitation: No adjusted EBITDA for the fourth quarter of 2025, no interim cash interest and no covenant calculation, so leverage and cover rest on a derived measure.
